, Reason for Mistake: The Planner compared only the month and day of birth (04-04 vs 05-22) and ignored the years, concluding Andrew Lau was born earlier than Homi Wadia. Correctly including years shows Andrew Lau (1960-04-04) was born long after Homi Wadia (1911-05-22), so the film with the director born first is Hanuman Patal Vijay.
